test_to_numeric_basic_conversion: test to_numeric converts string series like ["1", "-3.14", "7"] to numeric series [1, -3.14, 7]
test_to_numeric_error_handling: test to_numeric with errors="raise" raises ValueError on unparseable strings and errors="coerce" converts them to NaN
test_to_numeric_downcast: test to_numeric with downcast="integer" reduces int64 arrays to smallest integer dtype like int8 or int16
test_to_numeric_nullable_dtype_backend: test to_numeric with dtype_backend="numpy_nullable" returns nullable Int64 or Float64 series from object dtype input
test_to_numeric_large_numbers_and_specia: test to_numeric handles large integers, scientific notation, decimal types, datetime-like values, and NaN coercion without errors
